Police are searching for two men and a woman after a man was fatally stabbed in Geelong on Sunday afternoon.

A man, who is yet to be identified, was fatally stabbed during an altercation on Alkira Avenue, Norlane at about 12.40pm.

Police said it was believed that three men and two women were involved in the incident.

Despite efforts by emergency services to save his life, the man died at the scene.

A woman, in her 20s, was also treated by paramedics for minor injuries.

Victoria Police said that two men and a woman fled the scene.

It is believed that all parties were known to each other, police said.

No arrests have yet been made and an investigation by the Homicide Squad is underway.

Originally published as Police hunting for two men, woman after Geelong fatal stabbing
